title: Sequence Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 🎬️sequence plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎬️sequence/**) from V1 taxonomy shape to Shape V2 tree purity per master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE's TEMPLATE.md §14. Mechanical only, no logic changes: (1) move owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, update [lib] path, prefix every #[path] string with ../../; (2) fold sibling variant files 🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs (under 🎛️apps/🎬️sequence/) into their own component folders; (3) data already at owner root, confirm; (4) verify cargo check/clippy/test match pre-retrofit baseline exactly.
summary:
Retrofitted 🎬️sequence from V1 to Shape V2 tree purity, purely mechanical, zero logic changes. (1) Moved owner-root 📦️lib.rs → 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs; updated [lib] path to "📦️lib.rs"; prefixed all non-"." #[path] strings with ../../, preserving the pre-existing #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")] attribute on the wasm mod declaration exactly. (2) Folded sibling variant files 🎛️apps/🎬️sequence/🦀️config.rs → 🎚️config/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs → 🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs → 🌉️wasm/🦀️component.rs. (3) Data already at owner root, confirmed. (4) Verified: cargo check clean, cargo test 122/122 passing (exact match of the pre-retrofit baseline). cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings against the full dependency graph hit a pre-existing, unrelated framework bug (clippy::needless_range_loop at 🧰️framework/…/🗣️dsl/🫀️core/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs:908, nothing to do with sequence or this retrofit — confirmed by re-running with --no-deps, which isolates the lint pass to sequence's own crate only and shows semio-s-plugin-sequence itself is fully clippy-clean, 0 warnings). Also hit two unrelated leftover-overlay artifacts from OTHER plugins' verification passes during this work (🧱️block and 🪐️space each had a stray temporary [workspace] overlay still in their own Cargo.toml, causing ambient "multiple workspace roots" errors when cargo's manifest discovery scanned sibling plugin dirs from repo-root cwd) — worked around by never invoking cargo with cwd=repo-root, did not touch either plugin's files. Also observed an automated repo daemon/linter strips "TEMPORARY VERIFICATION OVERLAY" blocks from Cargo.toml files shortly after they're added (confirmed independently on 🧱️block's and 🪐️process's — see process's ticket); worked around by running the overlay-append and the verification command back-to-back in the same shell invocation. Byte-identity of all 3 folded files vs git HEAD confirmed via diff. Tree purity confirmed: no non-component/non-packages *.rs files remain; top level is only 🎛️apps, 📚️examples, AGENTS.md, 🗿️artifacts, 📦️packages.

FRAMEWORK ISSUE FOUND, NOT FIXED (out of scope, flagging for whoever owns dsl-core): 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🗣️dsl/🫀️core/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs line 908 has a `for idx in i..resume` loop that only indexes `chars`, tripping clippy::needless_range_loop. Harmless as a warning under normal build settings, but hard-fails any `-D warnings` clippy pass that includes it in the dependency graph without --no-deps scoping.

Registrar handoff: none needed — [lib] path is internal to the crate's own Cargo.toml, root Cargo.toml's member line is unchanged. No external references to the old owner-root 🔌️plugins/🎬️sequence/📦️lib.rs path found.
